description: Deterministic offline scenarios for the steerable Agent runtime. The core eval runner ignores this file; evals/run_steering_eval.py executes it.

scenarios.description: Text tokens stream before the terminal event.
A tool-call-only model turn still emits early progress.
APPEND received during a model call is applied at the next safe point.
REDIRECT during a model call cancels planned tool calls.
REDIRECT before a write starts leaves the file unchanged.
REDIRECT after a write reports the completed side effect.
REDIRECT between serial calls skips only the unstarted call.
REDIRECT during a parallel batch preserves paired tool replies.
Pause at a safe point and resume without busy polling.
Cancel while paused stops the run.
Bash stdout is visible before process exit.
Steering is accepted while a permission request is pending.
A persisted running state resumes without duplicate side effects.
A broken caller sink cannot stop the run.
Sensitive steering text never reaches events or the control log.
A slow event consumer does not deadlock high-frequency output.
Repeated read-only calls execute once and report cache hits.
